transcript: The National Institute of Medicine in Tokyo is a cutting-edge lab. The director is Dr. Tanaka, the deputy is Dr. Sato. Today's event is the final presentation of the Joint Research Project. Through collaboration with an American University A new drug has been developed The secretary, Yamada-san Prepared the presentation The participants are male and female In roughly equal numbers in the presentation Dr. Tanaka explained the properties Of the new drug's liquid compound Even a tiny unit for experiments Has an effect with few side effects The new drug was developed For cancer patients Facing an urgent need for new treatment The conditions of the clinical trial were strict Conducted over two years The participants' data were arranged in string-like graphs and projected on slides. The researchers stare at the screen. For transport of the drug load, steel containers are used. Temperature control is important. The graduate students of the lab also contributed to this achievement Maybe in a few years they will be the next leaders Dr. Tanaka with a one smile said This drug will save many lives I want to thank the research team who deserve the credit After the meeting, the participants headed towards the hotel for the dinner gathering Science advances through the power of teamwork you
